thread.title: MacDailyNews presents live notes from Apple’s Q318 conference call

author: MacDailyNews
title: MacDailyNews presents live notes from Apple’s Q318 conference call
text:
MacDailyNews ^ | July 31, 2017 4:45PM PDT
Posted on 07/31/2018 6:17:37 PM PDT by Swordmaker
>MacDailyNews presents live notes from Apples Q318 Conference Call with analysts starting at 5pm EDT/2pm PDT today.
Apple will provide live audio streaming of its Q318 Results Conference Call using Apples industry-leading QuickTime multimedia software.
The live webcast will begin at 2pm PDT/ 5pm EDT today here .
The company posted quarterly revenue of $53.3 billion, an increase of 17 percent from the year-ago quarter, and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $2.34, up 40 percent. International sales accounted for 60 percent of the quarters revenue.
For Q418, Apple guided for revenue between $60 billion and $62 billion.
Live notes from Apples Q318 Conference Call in reverse chronological order:Q
(reversed to chronological order with some editing to make it more sensible by Swordmaker)
AAPL after hours: $195.05, +4.76 (+2.50%) @ 4:45PM EDT AAPL after hours: $195.19, +4.90 (+2.58%) @ 4:50PM EDT Apple Revenue by Geographic Segment: Americas: $24.542 billion (+20% YOY) Europe: $12.138 billion (+14% YOY) Greater China: $9.551 billion (+19% YOY) Japan: $3.867 billion (+7% YOY) Rest of Asia Pacific; $3.167 billion (+16% YOY) AAPL after hours: $196.45, +6.16 (+3.24%) @ 4:55PM EDT Conference call begins Apple CEO Tim Cook Takes The Microphone: Were proud to report our best June quarter ever driven by continued strong sales of iPhone, Services, and Wearables. This is Apples fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth iPhone X was the most popular iPhone in the quarter as it has been since its release Paid subscriptions have now surpassed $300 million; revenue from subscriptions counts for a significant portion of Services App Store turned 10 years old this quarter App Store generated nearly twice the revenue of Google Play so far in 2018 AAPL after hours: $195.89, +5.60 (+2.94%) @ 5:04PM EDT Apps are generating tens of millions of jobs around the world Rapid growth in App Store search ad business Apple seeing strong growth in services; Apple Music grew over 50% YOY All-time highs for number of FaceTime calls and Siri requests Apple Pay over 1 billion transactions last quarter CVS and 7-11 will roll out Apple Pay across the U.S. this year Wearables up over 60% YOY (Apple Watch grew in mid 40% range YOY); AirPods sales are strong WWDC 2018 previewed many advancements coming this year to macOS, tvOS, iOS, and watchOS With iOS 12, Siri will take a major step forward with Siri Shortcuts iOS 12 adds tools to help customers understand and take control of the time spent with iOS devices AAPL after hours: $196.08, +5.79 (+3.04%) @ 5:12PM EDT Apple is uniquely positioned in AR because of control of both hardware and software iOS and macOS has shared a common foundation from the very beginning; now some iOS apps will be available on the Mac with macOS Mojave Mac App Store getting a full redesign this fall Privacy is one of the most important issues of the 21st century Apple Watch will receive major improvements with watchOS 5 Apple TV 4K has seen major growth as cable companies adopt Apple TV 4K to deliver their content We are always working to leave the world better than we found it First of its kind investment fun in China; $300 million China Clean Energy Fund Great momentum in Everyone Can Code and Everyone Can Create projects Apple teaming with leading educators in blind and deaf schools for Everyone Can Code Luca Maestri Takes Over The Microphone: Were very happy to report Apples best June quarter ever Quarterly revenue of $53.3 billion: iPhone: 41.3 million units (+1% YOY), $29.906 billion revenue (+20% YOY) Services: $9.548 billion (+31% YOY) Mac: 3.720 million units (-13% YOY), $5.330 billion revenue (-5% YOY) iPad: 11.553 million units (+1% YOY), $4.741 billion revenue (-5% YOY) Other Products: $3.740 billion (+37% YOY) Apple grew in each of Apples top 15 markets. iPhone channel inventory reduced by 3.5 million units during the quarter Services: Best results ever (double digit Services growth in every market) Mac: Double digit YOY growth; nearly 60% of purchase coming from customers who are new to Mac Enterprises are are deploying Macs due to employee choice programs Different timing of MacBook pro launch caused unfavorable YOY comparison Double digit iPad unit growth in China Almost half of iPad purchases in quarter were new to iPad NPD: iPad has 60% share, up from 51% YOY, in U.S. tablet market Apple is making great headway in the enterprise with iPhone and iPad Business Chat for iMessage seeing strong adoption Retail and Onlie Stores had a great quarter; over 250K Today at Apple sessions Apple opened 50th retail store in China during the quarter Net cash position $129.1 billion Apple plans to reach a net cash neutral position over time 112.8 million shares repurchased during the quarter Next Quarter Guidance: Apple is providing the following guidance for its fiscal 2018 fourth quarter: Revenue between $60 billion and $62 billion Gross margin between 38 percent and 38.5 percent Operating expenses between $7.95 billion and $8.05 billion Other income/(expense) of $300 million Tax rate of approximately 15 percent before discrete items Dividend Declared Apples board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.73 per share of the Companys common stock The dividend is payable on August 16, 2018 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on August 13, 2018 Tim Cook Takes The Microphone Back: Services results were very broad based. We couldnt be happier with how things are going. We are thrilled about our pipeline that has some new Services in it as well (streaming contentMDN Ed.) Microphone Back to Luca: Luca: We are very happy to see gross margin sequentially flat for June Foreign exchange has been a very significant headwind over the past 3-4 years, but weve been able to manage that Tim Cook Takes The Microphone Back: We feel great about iPhone results iPhone X is the most innovative smartphone on the market and we could not be happier that its been the top-selling iPhone since its launch Its clear that Apple picked up global smartphone and tablet market share in the quarter This is the 4th consecutive quarter that Apple has had double-digit growth in China Our view on tariffs is that they show up as a tax on consumers, but the trade agreements that the U.S. has with China and several other countries are in need of modernizing None of our products are directly affected by current tariffs; we are evaluating a fourth tariff which is in the comment period Risk associated due to tariffs is very difficult to quantify and Apple is not even trying to quantify it Apple is optimistic about U.S.- China trade relations Were very excited to work with Oprah We think we can do some great original content with Oprah We hired two very respected TV executives last year (Jamie Erlicht and Zach Van Amburg  MDN Ed.) We are not ready to talk about it yet, but we are very excited about what well eventually offer Cord-cutting is only going to accelerate Apple TV 4K units and revenue grew by very strong double-digits in Q318 Were really happy to be working on something that were not ready to talk about yet Apple Music has well over 50 million listeners (paid and trial users) Apple took leadership position in streaming music in the U.S. and Japan There is an extraordinary opportunity to grow streaming music Our revenues on Apple Music grew over 50% during Q3 Luca: We expect strong growth to come from iPhone, Services and Wearables Cook: I think the smartphone market is very healthy Smartphone market is a great market because its just huge. Some smartphone replacement cycles are lengthening due to subsidy plans becoming a much smaller percentage of sales iPhone X shows that when you deliver a great innovative product, people want it Apple has not conducted an analysis of how many people opted for low-cost battery replacement vs. buying a new iPhone A lot of people that buy Apple products buy for the whole ecosystem even if they do not utilize the entire ecosystem to start It is clear from my communications with customers that some are attracted to iPhone thanks to Apple Watch and AirPods; the reverse of that is also true AAPL after hours: $197.05, +6.76 (+3.55%) @ 6:00PM EDT End of the conference call KEYWORDS: applepinglist ; financialcall Monthly donors needed!
